headlines.title: iGMS Measures the Real Impact of New York's Short-Term Rental Law, Finding Supply 80% Below Where It Would Otherwise Be
headlines.summary: VANCOUVER, British Columbia, October 14, 2026--iGMS, the short-term rental management software for hosts growing beyond one platform, today released "What New York's Short-Term Rental Crackdown Actually Did," a study of Local Law 18. It measures New York against what the city would likely look like without the law, modeled on eight similar U.S. counties with no new rules, using data through May 2026.

description: Airbnb, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates a platform for stays, experiences, and services worldwide. The company's marketplace connects hosts and guests online or through mobile devices to book spaces, experiences, and services. It also offers gift cards. The company was formerly known as AirBed & Breakfast, Inc. and changed its name to Airbnb, Inc. in November 2010. Airbnb, Inc. was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
